scenarios.name: Keep Tools key tips visible after Escape with a face selected

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
one visible solid face is selected
the full Tools ribbon is selected
top-level key tips appear on the ribbon tabs and quick-access controls
key tips appear on the Tools ribbon commands
the top-level and Tools command key tips remain visible
the Tools ribbon and part remain visible
the selection indicator still reports one face
